name: kivren
description: Inspect an owner-connected computer and coordinate project work through a separately configured Kivren room connection.

interface.longDescription: Inspect files on a computer connected by its owner through Kivren. The bundled HTTP connection requires Kivren sign-in and computer consent. Room coordination additionally requires an owner-configured Kivren room MCP connection; computer access alone does not expose rooms or authorize coding. Skills follow the connected runtime's current rules and available tools.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the repository I select on my connected computer.
Summarize the current decisions and work in my connected Kivren project room.
